mapper.select: select o.status, count(*) as orders, sum(o.total) as total from purchase_order o where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.deleted_at is null group by o.status having count(*) > 0
select o.id, o.total, c.name as customer from purchase_order o join customer c on c.id = o.customer_id where o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by o.id
